items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a memory of him coming to my hotel room in Stockholm

ctx.x: Certainly it does. Whatever insecurities I brought into the mess are absorbed in my age now; my experience, and I feel more confident as a player.

I want to talk about a couple of people. I’m looking through this discography and not long after those sessions you did some stuff in Germany with Lars Gullin and Hans Koller. You knew Lars Gullin fairly well right?
